findings.finding: Each supplied num_subscribers equals its recent_subscribers raw row count. Raw rows are not unique accounts.
ThirdRailify snapshot row counts are 132, 137, 122; unique normalized usernames are 126, 131, 116.
The CHATS sample is user:vmzw3 / danielclancy, not user:1sl8zm / ThirdRailify.
September 1 to September 7 retains 99 records, adds 23 and removes 38; every removed record has amount_cents=0.
All ten earlier positive-amount ThirdRailify records persist; one new 500-cent record appears by September 7.
The supplied subscriber arrays are consistent with an evolving roster containing differently retained zero-amount and positive-amount records. A complete active-entitlement contract is not proven.
No subscriber active flag, expiry, cancellation, last-renewal, current-period, currency, invoice ID or immutable subscription ID appears. expires_on occurs only on Rants.
In every supplied subscriber record, user equals username; an immutable subscriber user ID is not demonstrated.
Some zero-amount records older than 30 days remain listed. Some disappear before exactly one calendar month from their own timestamp. No exact expiry formula is validated.
recurring_subscription badges appear on actors with only zero-amount subscriber records. The badge alone does not demonstrate direct payment or a successful monthly renewal.
Latest gifted_subs contains 1,143 distinct purchase-shaped records totalling 2,769 gifts, equal to num_gifted_subs. No explicit recipient-to-purchase foreign key is supplied.
Timestamp clustering between gift purchases and zero-amount subscriber rows supports a gifted-origin hypothesis, not definitive per-recipient assignment.

design_guardrails: Keep provider-listed status, payment evidence, renewal evidence and competition eligibility separate.
Use full validated source-scoped snapshots and qualified set differences, not latest-only notifications.
Never expire a positive-amount subscriber solely because subscribed_on is old.
Never infer a renewal charge merely because the same row persists.
Treat disappearance as observed absence until semantics/coverage are verified; do not call it an exact cancellation.
Do not infer lapse from silence or a failed/partial/stale snapshot.
Record badge sighting time; rereading the same old message is not fresh proof.
Preserve historical import evidence without executing past Wheel/Poll actions.
Freeze approved monthly participant lists and dedupe monthly membership awards separately from gift/Rant awards.
